reason: Record implementation of the remaining exact-review fixes before consolidated exact-head review.

operation.summary: Resolved the two remaining consolidated review findings after the five real Runtime v3 adapter fixes. Duplicate in-flight callers now wait on the owner result through a cancellation-aware watch channel and cannot become synthetic executors; each waiter can cancel independently without poisoning the owner result. writer.lock acquisition now publishes owner.json through a pending lock directory and recovers partial locks without owner metadata. Current touched source/test physical LoC is before 3796, after 3791, net -5.
changes: Replaced duplicate in-flight OnceCell get_or_init waiting with owner-only execution plus watch-based result notification, so duplicate callers honor their own CancellationToken and never initialize work.
Notified duplicate waiters on owner-side governed admission errors before removing the in-flight record.
Changed writer-lock acquisition to write owner.json inside a pending directory before publishing writer.lock, and to recover missing or invalid owner metadata as stale partial locks.
Kept ownership-checked writer lock release, live-pid stale detection, and explicit configured absolute state roots.
Trimmed the proof harness while retaining end-to-end coverage for real execution, scheduler reuse, checkpoint restore identity/integrity, live cancellation, and safe storage locking.
